{"consolidated_memory":"ui/components/DataTable.tsx: Series of six blank render incidents (2026-01-24 through 2026-08-26)

Component: ui/components/DataTable.tsx (web ui side, TypeScript)
Consistent symptom across all occasions: empty tbody with no console error
Common repro: open the table with a saved column layout
Test coverage: ui/components/DataTable.test.tsx

OCCASION 1 [2026-01-24]
Trigger: users sitting in negative UTC offset
Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind lazy relation
Fix: prefetched the relation in a single query (PR #1342, branch fix/blank-render-1)
Measured outcome: backlog cleared 73 minutes after deploy

OCCASION 2 [2026-03-24]
Trigger: two requests raced on the same key
Root cause: race in lazy initialisation
Fix: guarded the init with a double-checked lock (PR #3745, branch fix/blank-render-2)
Measured outcome: 14 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

OCCASION 3 [2026-04-11]
Trigger: sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
Root cause: schema drift between the migration and the model
Fix: regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum (PR #6493, branch fix/blank-render-3)
Measured outcome: throughput rose 97 percent, to 722 requests per second

OCCASION 4 [2026-05-04]
Trigger: after the client had already retried once
Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of the digest (PR #7736, branch fix/blank-render-4)
Measured outcome: job finished in 59 minutes instead of 5 hours

OCCASION 5 [2026-06-05]
Trigger: input list came in empty
Root cause: naive datetime compared against an aware one
Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge (PR #7991, branch fix/blank-render-5)
Measured outcome: cold start dropped 63 percent, to 950 ms

OCCASION 6 [2026-08-26]
Trigger: tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
Root cause: mutable default argument shared across calls
Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call (PR #8074, branch fix/blank-render-6)
Measured outcome: memory settled at 527 MB instead of climbing past 2 GB"}
